tools.name: generate_merged_documents
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to mail merge from Excel or CSV to PDF: personalized letters from a spreadsheet (thank-you letters for each donor, the same letter to 200 people with their names), certificates in bulk from a name list (award, completion, participation), or envelopes from a contact list

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: preview_mail_merge, generate_merged_documents · Private data: preview_mail_merge, generate_merged_documents · Public sink: preview_mail_merge, generate_merged_documents.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: preview_mail_merge, generate_merged_documents · Private data: preview_mail_merge, generate_merged_documents · Public sink: preview_mail_merge, generate_merged_documents

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
